A.method: Grid plan from substation voltage, distance and study time, with an expert range around it (late case = 1.5 × median)

fuel_cell.ref: No AP-42 factor; treated as negligible (assumption)

notes: Emissions = model dispatch in the peak year x heat rate x AP-42 factor.
PTE = installed MW x 8,760 h; a synthetic minor permit caps hours (or fuel) below the major-source line.
Engine factors include SCR and oxidation catalyst reductions (assumption: NOx -90%, CO -90%, VOC -50%).

monteCarlo.method: Hourly run of the recommended on-site plant, over 500 possible grid-arrival months

steps: WECC (non-ISO) large-load interconnection study: +24 months before any grid import (assumption)
Best substation within 5 mi: CALIENTE (345 kV, 2.6 mi); assumed headroom 150 MW for that voltage
Farther than 2 mi: +6 months for a line extension
Headroom covers the target: 60 MW from month 48, 120 MW from month 54
